name: Campaign Deck Builder
description: Turn a short interview into a charming, vibrant 3-slide marketing-campaign deck by filling a bundled PowerPoint template.
author: Adi Leibowitz
coverImageAlt: Three blank campaign panels unfolding from a single faceted idea form.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a single compact idea sculpture unfolds into three polished campaign presentation panels, expressing a short interview becoming a vibrant three-part launch story
Scene/backdrop: warm-paper studio field over a deep slate plinth with understated editorial depth
Subject: three distinct blank physical panels fanned as a cohesive triptych, emerging from one small faceted conversation-seed form and linked by a narrow sparing-orange ribbon of motion
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, layered card stock, painted ceramic, and restrained dimensional shadows
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; scale the full triptych and seed form down so every part sits within the central 80%, with at least 10% completely clear space on all four edges; clear three-panel rhythm and strong silhouette; generous outer crop-safe margin; readable at small gallery-card size
Lighting/mood: upbeat but composed, capable, quietly technical; cyan edge light and restrained warm orange glow
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: the three panels must be completely blank abstract surfaces, not slide screenshots or UI; no text, pseudo-writing, glyphs, letters, numbers, icons, charts, logos, trademarks, watermark, labels, interface chrome, or product UI; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no Microsoft branding or Fluent gradient
